mapper.insert: insert ignore into outbound_requests (request_id, house_id, task_id, payload_hash, status) values (#{requestId}, #{houseId}, #{taskId}, #{payloadHash}, #{status})
mapper.update: update outbound_requests set status = 'CONFLICT', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, conflicts_json = #{conflictsJson}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update outbound_requests set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, sale_order_id = null, conflicts_json = null, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update outbound_requests set status = 'COMPLETED', sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId}, error_code = null, error_message = null, conflicts_json = null, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'PROCESSING'
